title: The Sea Parts, and Abraham Questions the Idols

paragraphs.text: Allah gave those gardens, springs and treasures to the Children of Israel as an inheritance. Pharaoh's army followed Moses and his people at sunrise. When the two groups saw each other, the companions of Moses were afraid. They said, "We will surely be caught!" But Moses was calm and sure. He said, "No! My Lord is with me, and He will guide me." Then Allah inspired Moses to strike the sea with his staff. The sea split apart, and each part stood like a huge, tall mountain. Allah brought the chasing army close. He saved Moses and everyone with him, all together. Then He drowned the others. In this there is a clear sign, but most of them did not believe. Your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

The Prophet is told to recite the news of Abraham to the people. Abraham asked his father and his people, "What do you worship?" They answered, "We worship idols, and we stay devoted to them." Abraham asked them simple questions. Do these idols hear you when you call on them? Can they bring you any benefit, or can they cause you harm? The people had no real answer. They only said, "We found our fathers doing the same." So Abraham asked them to think carefully about what they had been worshipping all this time.
